title: Conflict Explanation Envelope
purpose: Make unresolved learner-authored rules inspectable without turning explanation order or emphasis into a new precedence rule.
rules: Do not recommend, rank, hide, collapse, or visually privilege a competing rule.
Use a declared semantically arbitrary order.
Inspecting one rule is not selecting it.
Resolution remains an explicit learner act and deferral remains valid.
The explanation layer cannot modify the underlying rules.
